newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ASX to launch three new indices on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ASX to launch three new indices on Wednesday.

text.p: The Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) said on Tuesday it would commence the calculation of three new sector indices and discontinue three others effective from the start of trade on Wednesday, October 30.

The ASX said the three new indices would be energy .AXEY, infrastructure and utilities .AXIU and telecommunications .AXTE. The three to be discontinued would be entrepreneurial .AEII, Oil and Gas .AOGI and solid fuels .ASEI.
A spokesman from the ASX said the new energy sector would combine stocks from the solid fuels and oil and gas sectors.
Stocks previously included in the entrepreneurial sector would be allocated to the sectors that most accurately fitted their mix of business.
"The All Ordinaries index will not be affected by the changes," he said.
